title: Hooknostic Agent Definition 0.1 frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of an agent definition file (provisional; see docs/spec/agents/0.1.md). The instructions are the Markdown body after the frontmatter and are not part of this schema.

name.description: The agent's name; equals the file stem.

description.description: Single-line routing text: when to use this agent.

mode.description: Where the agent is offered: for delegation (subagent), as the agent a session runs as (primary), or both (all).

native.description: Harness-only fields, keyed by the consumer's harness identifier. The consumer rejects identifiers it does not know and keys the portable core owns.
